assessment.reasoning: Nestwell Studio has only 1 experiment slot remaining, which costs roughly 2.8x the annual promotional profit pool. None of the four available interventions offer a positive expected contribution return. Free shipping (int_shipping) waives Rs. 160, reducing contribution per order from Rs. 864 to Rs. 704 (-18.5%), requiring a conversion jump from 5.6% to 6.87% (+1.27 percentage points) just to break even—a mistake already highlighted in trading notes where a previous free-shipping trial was judged on conversion alone without checking contribution. Bundling (int_bundle) targets SKUs that support tickets show customers already buy together, subsidizing existing organic demand rather than driving incremental volume. General discounts (int_flat and int_pct) reduce unit economics across mobile-heavy bounce traffic and high-intent buyers alike. With no intervention targeted strictly at deadstock clearance or gated by a high AOV threshold, spending the merchant's sole experiment is negative expected value.
